text:
Neha: Heads-up — Lina submitted her resignation today. Last day 2026-12-01. We need to confirm benefits end date, COBRA packet timing, equity cliff/vesting pro rata, laptop return, and transfer of GitHub org admin rights.

Jordan: Confirmed. Lina wants an exit chat on 11/30 at 4pm PT. She9s been org-admin on github.com/redwood-infra and primary owner of infra-templates repo.

Neha: Quick benefits note: for US-based employees benefits run through month-end, so health active through 2026-12-31; COBRA election notice will go out 2027-01-01 (BenefitPro). Lina will have 60 days to elect. If she9s enrolled in commuter or FSA, we9ll send cost/recap and COBRA options where applicable.

Priya: Payroll — final paycheck processed on normal cycle; accrued PTO payout will be included. Need last working day to calculate proration for restricted stock unit (RSU) vesting timeline; equity team prefers note to comp@ by 12/02.

Lina: I9ll be remote in Seattle on last day. Happy to ship laptop back; prefer prepaid label. Also please don't close my access before 12/02 local time so I can ship items.

Carlos: Got it. We9ll schedule deprovisioning 2026-12-02 09:00 PT to avoid blocking her return shipments. Need GitHub handle, Okta username, laptop serial, and list of any long-lived tokens.

Jordan: GitHub: lina-dev. Okta: lina@redwood.com. Laptop serial: ZX9900UK. She owns a OpsPager duty schedule and a few IAM roles in prod-analytics.

Neha: Action list from HR: 1) Send exit interview invite (11/30 4pm PT) 2) Benefits summary + COBRA estimate on 2027-01-01 3) Offboarding survey after exit call.

Carlos: IT plan: 12/02 09:00 PT 9 disable Okta and revoke sessions; 09:15 remove SSH keys and revoke personal API tokens; 10:00 rotate any service account keys Lina created. Will attach ticket IT-4701 here.

ops-bot: Created IT ticket IT-4701: "Deprovision lina@redwood.com & transfer ownership" - https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/IT-4701 :robot_face:

Jordan: GitHub ownership: Lina is the last admin on infra-templates. I can transfer to team-admins but need confirmation of which repos and who becomes primary owner. Suggest team-admins + me as backup.

Carlos: Reminder: rotate vault tokens and check for any personal AWS access keys. Use this command to list keys: `aws iam list-access-keys --user lina` and grep for stale tokens. I'll run it 12/02 morning.

Priya: Equity note: comp@ will calculate prorated RSU vesting and finalize paperwork by 12/05. I'll cc Lina and Jordan.

Lina: Thanks all. Can we keep Slack account active until 12/02 afternoon? I need to coordinate a handover thread.

Carlos: We9ll suspend Slack SSO on 12/02 09:00 PT but leave the account in disabled state for 7 days so messages remain accessible, per retention policy.

Neha: Please DM Lina the benefit packet and COBRA Qs. Jordan please prepare a short handover doc listing repo owners and runbook owners before 11/29.

Jordan: Will do a quick runbook and post to internal wiki by 11/29 EOD. Also will add team-admins to infra-templates today.

Carlos: Final ops checklist I'll complete and paste to IT-4701: Okta disable, revoke sessions, remove keys, rotate service keys, remove PagerDuty schedule membership, close IT-4701 when done.

Neha: TL;DR next steps: HR sends benefits/COBRA details on 2027-01-01, IT performs deprovision on 12/02, payroll/equity teams finalize pay and RSU proration by 12/05, Jordan to transfer repo ownership + prepare runbook. Lina: exit interview 11/30 4pm PT.

Lina: Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear plan. I9ll send my handover notes tonight.

Neha: Thanks everyone 44d
